newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila Central Bank drops rediscount rate for Feb.
newsitem.headline: Manila Central Bank drops rediscount rate for Feb.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank said on Thursday it dropped its rediscounting rate for February to 9.673 percent from 10.679 percent.
The rediscount rate, which is changed monthly, is based on a pre-determined formula computed at one percentage point below the average 91-day Treasury bill rate of the last auction of the month.
The rediscounting facility of the Central Bank is aimed at giving concessional financing to exports and the finance sector, and not as a monetary tool.

From January 2 to 28, loans from the rediscounting facility reached 588 million pesos, of which 389 million pesos went to export financing and the rest to the agriculture sector, the Central Bank said.
